evidence_policy_as_stated_by_the_source.verbatim_qualifier: Houston's list was independently verified through the official Texans release; the other RotoWire inactive lists should remain REPORTED_HIGH_CONFIDENCE rather than CONFIRMED_OFFICIAL until matched to an NFL or team release.

COMPLETENESS.why_it_matters: The source states RotoWire now displays populated inactive lists for all nine games, and it relays the names that matter for football. It does not relay the complete contents of any list. So a DK player who is simply not mentioned is NOT established as not-on-the-list: he is unresolved. Treating silence as activation is the same defect as treating missing as zero, and it would wrongly activate roughly 420 rows.
COMPLETENESS.consequence: players named here resolve; every other DK row stays UNKNOWN_NOT_RELAYED.

identity_conflicts.subject: Kenneth Walker III (KC), David Montgomery (HOU), Michael Pittman Jr. (PIT), Carnell Tate (TEN), Jadarian Price (SEA), Malachi Fields (NYG)
identity_conflicts.first_pass_claim: The attached projection export contains visible team/player mapping anomalies, including Kenneth Walker listed with Kansas City and David Montgomery with Houston.
identity_conflicts.resolution: NOT A CONFLICT. The authoritative DK contest file carries the same clubs and the same salaries -- Kenneth Walker III KC 7400, David Montgomery HOU 6000, Michael Pittman Jr. PIT 4700, Carnell Tate TEN 5000, Jadarian Price SEA 5300, Malachi Fields NYG 4400. Three sources agree; there is nothing to reconcile.
identity_conflicts.note: The first pass called these mapping errors on the strength of their being surprising. They are not errors. Recorded because an unreal conflict left standing costs as much attention as a real one.

identity_conflicts.subject: Matthew McClain (NYJ)
identity_conflicts.claim: the second pass names Matthew McClain as a predicted NYJ starter and as a route-access gainer from Mitchell's absence
identity_conflicts.resolution: NO SUCH PLAYER in the DK 457. The universe carries Malik McClain, NYJ WR, 3000. A first-name substitution is the most likely reading but it is not established, so the name is NOT silently rewritten.
identity_conflicts.handling: Malik McClain is carried as a redistribution candidate with this conflict attached. No availability state is derived from the misnamed row.

environment_second_pass.note: implied totals in the source are arithmetic from the displayed spread and total, not projections. Recorded as the source's own market reading.

dk_eligible_field_semantics: INFORMATIONAL ONLY and not load-bearing. DK eligibility is decided by joining the relayed name to the authoritative DK 457, which availability.reported_index does on every run. This field was wrong for Ashton Dulin and Alec Pierce in the first draft of this file precisely because it was typed rather than derived, and the join caught both. Never branch on it.

rotowire_predicted_lineups.NOT_OFFICIAL: a predicted lineup is a projection of who will start. It is never a confirmed starting declaration, and a player named here gains no availability status from being named.
